description: Use for prices in shops, for example butter, bread or milk, for the shopping basket and for excise duty (akcyza) in the price of cigarettes, alcohol and fuel. Average retail prices of 30 goods and services in Poland from GUS (bread, butter, milk, eggs, meat, vegetables, sugar, electricity, gas, heating, petrol, diesel, bus ticket, taxi, haircut, doctor visit, cinema) for the latest month, with change vs the previous month and the same month a year earlier and the minutes of work each costs at the average net wage; plus the finwire shopping basket of 10 staple foods (finwire_shopping_basket_index). Also excise duty (akcyza) and VAT in the price of a pack of cigarettes, vodka, beer, wine (GUS yearly prices) and a litre of petrol and diesel at the rates in force today, announced excise rate changes (alcohol, tobacco, e-cigarettes, fuel) and the share of excise in the cigarette pack price (finwire_cigarette_excise_share).

product.description: Product name in Polish, e.g. "masło", "chleb", "benzyna"; returns that item with its monthly price history. Omit for all items.

name: get_retail_prices
title: Retail prices in shops (GUS)
